title: Emission factor
description: One record: one published greenhouse-gas emission factor (e.g. kg CO2e per passenger-km for a long-haul economy flight, per hotel room-night in a country, per kg of beef), exactly as an official or reference dataset publishes it. Voyager use: the trip carbon footprint (flights, ground transport, stays, food, activities).

activity.description: Stable snake_case slug of the activity, built from the publisher's own labels (e.g. "flights_long_haul_to_from_uk_economy_class", "hotel_stay_france", "beef_beef_herd").

activity_label.description: The publisher's own label path of the activity (e.g. "Flights / Long-haul, to/from UK / Economy class").

geography.description: Where the factor applies: an English country name, a region the publisher names, or "global".

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code when the factor is for one country.

unit.description: Unit of `value` as published, written "<mass> <gas> per <activity unit>" (e.g. "kg CO2e per passenger.km", "kg CO2e per room per night", "kg CO2e per kg").

value.description: The factor exactly as published, in `unit`.

gas_basis.description: Gases covered: CO2 only, CO2 equivalent (all Kyoto gases), or for flights CO2e with or without the radiative-forcing uplift for non-CO2 effects.

scope.description: The publisher's scope or life-cycle boundary (e.g. "Scope 3", "farm to retail").

year.description: The factor set's reference year (e.g. 2026 for the DESNZ 2026 factors).

publisher.description: Who publishes the factor (e.g. "UK Department for Energy Security and Net Zero").

dataset.description: The dataset and edition (e.g. "UK GHG conversion factors 2026, flat file v1.2").

factor_id.description: The publisher's own id of the factor row, when it has one.

source_url.description: The page's own link for this item (official site or detail page), copied verbatim from the page.

as_of.description: The "last updated", "valid from" or publication date the page itself states for this information (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.description: A verbatim quote from the page.

evidence.description: Up to 3 short verbatim quotes from the page that support the most important facts.
